content.comment_body: Hello, I previously used a mathematical instruction in [article_no]. In the function block, there was a 'reference' button that allowed selecting a value from another block to use as an argument. The program was originally created in [product_name] V7.1. When I open it in [product_name] V8.0, the 'reference' button is still visible. However, if I copy the block into a new project, the 'reference' button disappears, and selecting a new block in V8.0 no longer shows the 'reference' button. Now, I can only enter fixed values as arguments. How can I select a value from another block as an argument in [article_no]? Any guidance would be appreciated. Thank you.
Once you close the block's property settings, on the main program screen you'll see a small grey block with a '+' just below the block. Click on this grey block to access the needed option.
Refer to this link for more information: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble with the reference function when copying mathematical instruction blocks between projects using different versions of [product_name] software. In version 8.0, the reference button is missing or behaves differently, limiting users to fixed values only unless a workaround is known. This impacts usability and ease of referencing values between program blocks, which is essential for efficient configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to choose and reference variable values from other blocks within mathematical instruction blocks, as was possible in earlier software versions.
